title: Haughton Mars Project simulation and Chris McKay lecture

tellings.quote: we essentially played like we were Mars astronauts and my role was the robot guy

plain: John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the US military's research agency, who says he was abducted by an alien, says that in 2001 he took part in the Haughton Mars Project, a practice mission at Haughton Crater on Devon Island in the far north of Canada where a team pretended to be astronauts on Mars. He says his role was "the robot guy," and he names fellow participants and a lecture by the scientist Chris McKay as part of that time.
